bks_metadata.source: OR-Library jobshop1 + Taillard (1993) benchmark best-known solutions

metadata.budget_unit: objective queries including cache hits; actual decodes also reported
metadata.controlled_components: Fixed GA parameters; scheduled LS; best-individual capped VND; terminal refinement disabled for all.
metadata.fp_rule: Reliable affine operator residual <= threshold; no legacy stage/stagnation gates.
metadata.drift_rule: Same normalized state and weighted L2 norm, one observation lag.
metadata.probes: All eligible states on independent GA+LS trajectories; never committed; RNG/cache/budget isolated.
metadata.query_cap_behavior: All search operators retain the best evaluated candidate on cap; unused VND allocation goes to GA+LS.
metadata.runtime_note: All arms compute FP diagnostics; timings include observation overhead, not native trigger-only runtime.
metadata.threshold_note: Frozen heuristic thresholds, no tuning on reported outcomes; no universal irreplaceability claim.

probe_analysis.scope: Detached probes on neutral GA+LS states, not solely FP-selected states. Precision is conditional on common fitted/reliable states, without deployment cooldown.

audit: Passed all paired initialization, query budget, event and gain consistency checks.
